title: Add cold-start profiling baselines and reporting pipeline
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Context: Benchmark lab has good steady-state profiling but we lack systematic cold-start baselines for representative workloads. This PR adds a cold-start workload runner, a profiling baseline set, and a reporting pipeline stage that uploads cold-start metrics to the existing benchmarking dashboard. Motivation: cold-start latency is a primary P99 regression vector after kernel/quantization changes and on new hardware; having baselines and automated reporting reduces regression risk and speeds troubleshooting. What this PR does: - Adds a cold_start runner that orchestrates fresh JVM/Python process starts and model warm-up sequences for representative workloads. - Captures per-token and end-to-end cold-start P50/P90/P99, memory, and GPU utilization traces. - Integrates results into the benchmark-lab reporting pipeline (new reporting stage cold_start_summary). - Adds profiling baseline fixtures (yaml) for x86 and a100/rtx families. - Updates docs and dashboard mapping. Checklist: - [x] Add cold_start runner and workload definitions - [x] Produce baseline YAML artifacts under benchmarking/baselines/ - [x] Wire new stage into CI reporting pipeline (profile -> upload -> dashboard) - [x] Add tests: unit tests for runner harness + perf-smoke job - [x] Reviewer approvals and perf sign-off How to run locally: 1) ./tools/benchmark lab run --workload cold_start --model gpt-small --seeds 3 2) ./tools/benchmark-lab profile --baseline baselines/cold_start/a100.yaml 3) See output in /tmp/benchmark-output/<run-id> and validate with ./tools/benchmark-lab check-report <run-id> Notable implementation details: - The runner intentionally spawns a fresh process per trial to simulate true cold-start paths and clears KV cache between trials. - We limit sampling to small sample sets by default and surface flags for scale-up in CI. - Reporting stage reuses the existing reporting lambda; added a small adapter to translate profiling metrics into the dashboard schema. Rollout plan: merged to main, will run a weekly cold-start profiling job for the next 4 weeks and surface regressions as retrospective alerts to #perf-alerts. Related: ENG-3182, ENG-3221, SUP-9041
